The '''Generator Facility''' was located in the [[Glarus Valley]] on [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] and powered the defensive systems of the [[House Cortess (estate)|House Cortess estate]]. Around [[3643 BBY]] the facility was infiltrated by [[Cipher Nine]] and [[Vector Hyllus]], who used the [[Killik/Legends|Killiks]] to disable the generators, allowing them to storm the estate.
